annotations.title: Get homes.com property history (DEPRECATED — use homes_get_history)

description: DEPRECATED — prefer `homes_get_history` (combined timelines + tax) or `homes_get_property({ url, include_price_history: true })`. Same data, fewer round trips. Will be removed in a future major version. Three timelines for a homes.com property in one call: `listing_events`, `ownership_events`, `lien_events`. Also returns `events_normalized` mapped onto the cross-MCP enum. Each `events_normalized` row is `{ date, type, price?, price_change_pct?, list_to_sale_pct? }` — `price_change_pct` only on `PriceChange` rows; every other row carries homes.com's "List to Sale" figure as `list_to_sale_pct` (e.g. the sale-to-list ratio on a `Sold` row), never as a price change.

url.description: homes.com property detail URL or path.
